marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots diminishing to light this morning then
increasing to west 15 early this evening. Wind veering to northwest 20 late
overnight. Wind northwest 20 Wednesday. Flurries. Fog patches dissipating early this
evening. Temperatures minus 3 falling to minus 9 Wednesday
afternoon. Freezing spray beginning Wednesday morning. <br/>
